identity.summary: An attacker uses Add-MpPreference to exclude a path or extension from Windows Defender, enabling them to stage a payload for execution. Cortex should detect this new exclusion as a potential adversary

biocs.name: New Defender Exclusion Added
biocs.description: Detection of new Windows Defender exclusions added via Add-MpPreference
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and action_command_line contains 'Add-MpPreference'
| filter action_file_path contains 'payload.exe'
